dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses CALL 'system' and CALL 'MONFUNC' patterns typical of ORCA
evidence: Project code name ORCA, Copyright JMA 2002

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system - medical image data save subprogram for medication/treatment image registration (tbl_med_image)
purpose.summary: This subprogram saves a medical image file to the database. It base64-encodes an image file from a temporary directory, reads the encoded data, then performs a DB SELECT/FETCH to check existence and either inserts or updates the record in tbl_med_image via the MONFUNC database interface. It cleans up the temporary file on exit.

notable_features: CALL 'system' to execute shell commands (base64 encoding, rm -f)
CALL 'MONFUNC' for database operations (DBSELECT, DBFETCH, DBINSERT, DBUPDATE, DBCLOSECURSOR)
LINKAGE SECTION with USING clause (subprogram interface)
Large PIC X(500000) image record and PIC X(510000) MCPREC
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP/Shift-JIS (latin-1 decoded as garbled)
verdict.notes: Japanese comments are garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. Program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS; database access is via proprietary MONFUNC call interface.
